note: Listening passages (Path stops of kind l). Each is a short dialogue: lines spoken by 女 (the woman's voice) or 男 (the man's voice), then questions in Chinese with four options (the first option in the file is the right one; the site shuffles them). line = the index of the line that holds the answer (it is played again after the question is answered). Words: only words of this level and the levels below. The Path places each passage right after the stop that teaches the last of its words (tools/build-path.py). passages.title: Today's new dish
passages.scene: A waiter helps a woman order for her family.

lines.zh: 服务员，请给我们菜单。
lines.en: Waiter, please bring us the menu.

lines.zh: 好的。今天我们的新菜是鱼，您要不要尝一尝？
lines.en: Sure. Today our new dish is fish. Would you like to try it?

lines.zh: 好啊，来一个鱼，再来一碗米饭和两杯茶。
lines.en: OK, one fish, plus a bowl of rice and two cups of tea.

lines.zh: 还要别的吗？
lines.en: Do you need anything else?

lines.zh: 有甜的吗？孩子喜欢吃甜的。
lines.en: Do you have anything sweet? The child likes sweet things.

lines.zh: 我们有蛋糕和冰激凌。
lines.en: We have cake and ice cream.

lines.zh: 那来一个冰激凌吧。
lines.en: Then one ice cream.

qs.en: What is today's new dish?
How many cups of tea did the woman order?
Who likes sweet things?

qs.zh: 最后女的要了什么甜的？
qs.en: Which sweet thing did the woman order in the end?

passages.title: Is there a bank nearby?
passages.scene: A man asks a woman for directions.

lines.zh: 请问，附近有银行吗？
lines.en: Excuse me, is there a bank nearby?

lines.zh: 有，你往前走，到第二个路口往右走。
lines.en: Yes. You go straight ahead and turn right at the second junction.

lines.zh: 是在红绿灯那儿吗？
lines.en: Is that where the traffic lights are?

lines.zh: 对，过了红绿灯，银行就在路边，在一个超市旁边。
lines.en: Yes. Once you have passed the traffic lights, the bank is right by the road, next to a supermarket.

lines.zh: 走过去要多久？
lines.en: How long does it take to walk there?

lines.zh: 差不多十分钟吧。
lines.en: About ten minutes.

qs.en: What does the man want to find?
At which junction do you turn right?
What is the bank next to?
How long does it take to walk there?

passages.title: The flight is late
passages.scene: A couple wait at the airport.

lines.zh: 你的护照带了吗？
lines.en: Did you bring your passport?

lines.zh: 带了，在我的包里。
lines.en: Yes, I brought it. It is in my bag.

lines.zh: 我们的飞机几点起飞？
lines.en: What time does our plane take off?

lines.zh: 飞机是十点的，但是我刚才听说晚点了，要十一点半才起飞。
lines.en: The flight is at ten, but I just heard it is late: it will only take off at half past eleven.

lines.zh: 还有两个多小时，我们先去吃饭吧。
lines.en: There are still over two hours. Let's go and eat first.

lines.zh: 好，行李我来拿。
lines.en: OK, I will carry the luggage.

qs.en: Where is the man's passport?
What time will the plane take off now?

qs.zh: 为什么飞机不是十点起飞？
qs.en: Why will the plane not take off at ten?
What are they going to do now?

passages.title: Seventy in maths
passages.scene: Two classmates talk about a maths exam.

lines.zh: 这次数学考试你考得怎么样？
lines.en: How was your result in this maths exam?

lines.zh: 不太好，我只考了七十分。
lines.en: Not very well. I only got 70.

lines.zh: 是不是题太难了？
lines.en: Were the questions too hard?

lines.zh: 题不难，是我没有认真复习。最近每天晚上都在玩游戏。
lines.en: They were not hard; I did not revise properly. Recently I have been playing games every evening.

lines.zh: 下次考试前，我们一起去图书馆复习吧。
lines.en: Before the next exam, let's revise together at the library.

lines.zh: 好啊，谢谢你。
lines.en: Good idea, thank you.

qs.en: What score did the woman get in maths?

qs.zh: 女的觉得为什么没考好？
qs.en: In the woman's view, why did the exam not go well?

qs.zh: 女的最近每天晚上做什么？
qs.en: What has the woman been doing every evening recently?

qs.zh: 男的说下次去哪儿复习？
qs.en: Where does the man say they will revise next time?

passages.title: Wind and rain
passages.scene: A woman stops a man from cycling in bad weather.

lines.zh: 外面刮大风了，还下雨。
lines.en: It is very windy outside, and it is raining too.

lines.zh: 真的？我今天要骑自行车去上班。
lines.en: Really? Today I am going to cycle to work.

lines.zh: 别骑了，不安全。
lines.en: Do not ride any more; it is not safe.

lines.zh: 那我坐地铁吧。
lines.en: Then I will take the metro.

lines.zh: 对，带上伞，别感冒了。
lines.en: Right. Take an umbrella and do not catch a cold.

lines.zh: 好，谢谢你关心我。
lines.en: OK, thank you for caring about me.

qs.en: What is the weather like outside?

qs.zh: 男的一开始想怎么去上班？
qs.en: At first, how does the man want to get to work?
How does the man get to work in the end?
What does the woman tell the man to take?

passages.title: The New Year party
passages.scene: Two classmates talk about a school party.

lines.zh: 明天晚上的新年晚会你参加吗？
lines.en: Are you going to the New Year party tomorrow evening?

lines.zh: 参加，我还要表演一个节目。
lines.en: Yes, and I am also going to perform.

lines.zh: 真的？你表演什么？
lines.en: Really? What are you performing?

lines.zh: 我和两个同学一起唱中文歌。
lines.en: Two classmates and I are singing Chinese songs together.

lines.zh: 太好了！晚会几点开始？
lines.en: Great! What time does the party start?

lines.zh: 七点，在学校的体育馆。
lines.en: At seven, in the school sports hall.

qs.en: When is the party?
What is the woman going to perform?
Who is the woman performing with?
Where is the party?

passages.title: A fever
passages.scene: A woman sees that a friend is unwell.

lines.zh: 你怎么了？看起来不太舒服。
lines.en: What is wrong with you? You do not look very well.

lines.zh: 我可能发烧了，头也很疼。
lines.en: I might have a fever, and my head hurts a lot too.

lines.zh: 你去医院检查一下吧。
lines.en: You should go to the hospital for a check-up.

lines.zh: 没事，我休息一下就好了。
lines.en: It is nothing. I will be fine after a rest.

lines.zh: 别这样，发烧要马上看医生。我跟你一起去。
lines.en: Do not be like that: with a fever you should see a doctor right away. I will go with you.

lines.zh: 好吧，那我们现在就去。
lines.en: All right, then let's go now.

qs.en: What is wrong with the man?
What does the woman tell the man to do?
At first, what does the man want to do?
Who is going to the hospital with the man?

passages.title: Next year in China
passages.scene: A man asks a woman about her plans.

lines.zh: 你明年有什么打算？
lines.en: What are your plans for next year?

lines.zh: 我打算去中国留学，为了提高我的汉语水平。
lines.en: I plan to study in China, to improve my Chinese.

lines.zh: 如果去中国，你想去哪个城市？
lines.en: If you go to China, which city do you want to go to?

lines.zh: 我想去南方，因为我怕冷。
lines.en: I want to go to the south, because I am afraid of the cold.

lines.zh: 那你要先准备好护照和钱。
lines.en: Then you need to get your passport and money ready first.

lines.zh: 对，我现在每个周末都在饭馆工作。
lines.en: Right. I work at a restaurant every weekend now.

qs.en: What does the woman plan to do next year?
Why does the woman want to go to China?
Where does the woman want to go?
Why does the woman want to go to the south?

passages.title: The new neighbour
passages.scene: A woman who has just moved in meets her neighbour.

lines.zh: 你好，我是新搬来的邻居，就住在你对面。
lines.en: Hello, I am the new neighbour who has just moved in. I live right across from you.

lines.zh: 欢迎欢迎！我在这儿住了三年了，有什么需要可以找我。
lines.en: Welcome! I have lived here for three years. If you need anything, you can come to me.

lines.zh: 谢谢！请问附近哪儿有超市？
lines.en: Thank you! Excuse me, where is there a supermarket nearby?

lines.zh: 出了小区往左走，大概五百米就有一个大超市，晚上十一点才关门。
lines.en: Leave the estate and turn left; about 500 metres on there is a big supermarket. It does not close until eleven at night.

lines.zh: 太好了。还有，垃圾我应该放在哪儿？
lines.en: Great. Also, where should I put the rubbish?

lines.zh: 楼下有四个垃圾桶，要按颜色放。
lines.en: There are four bins downstairs, and you have to sort it by colour.

lines.zh: 好的，我会注意的。以后有问题我再找你。
lines.en: OK, I will be careful about it. If I have a problem later, I will come to you again.

qs.en: Where does the woman live?
How long has the man lived here?
What time does the supermarket close at night?
How should the rubbish be put out?

passages.title: After the interview
passages.scene: A woman asks a friend about his job interview.

lines.zh: 我听说你昨天去面试了，怎么样？
lines.en: I heard you had an interview yesterday. How did it go?

lines.zh: 还不错，经理问了我很多问题，我都回答得很流利。
lines.en: Not bad. The manager asked me a lot of questions, and I answered all of them fluently.

lines.zh: 那家公司的工资高吗？
lines.en: Is the pay at that company high?

lines.zh: 比我现在的工资高一千块，但是经常要加班。
lines.en: It is 1,000 yuan more than my pay now, but you often have to work overtime.

lines.zh: 加班有加班费吗？
lines.en: Is there overtime pay?

lines.zh: 有。他们说下个星期会通知我结果。
lines.en: Yes. They say they will let me know the result next week.

lines.zh: 祝你成功！
lines.en: I wish you success!

qs.en: What did the man do yesterday?

qs.zh: 那家公司的工资怎么样？
qs.en: What is the pay like at that company?
opts: 比男的现在的高一千块
比男的现在的低一千块
比男的现在的高两千块

qs.en: What is the downside of that company?

qs.zh: 男的什么时候能知道结果？
qs.en: When will the man know the result?

passages.title: Renting a flat
passages.scene: A man asks an agent about a flat for rent.

lines.zh: 这个房子一个月房租多少钱？
lines.en: How much is the rent for this flat a month?

lines.zh: 四千五百块，水电费不在房租里，要自己付。
lines.en: It is 4,500 yuan. Water and electricity are not in the rent; you need to pay them yourself.

lines.zh: 有点儿贵。厨房和客厅大吗？
lines.en: That is a bit expensive. Are the kitchen and living room big?

lines.zh: 客厅很大，厨房小一点儿，但是很干净，家具都是新的。
lines.en: The living room is big and the kitchen is a little smaller, but it is very clean, and all the furniture is new.

lines.zh: 离地铁站远吗？
lines.en: Is it far from the metro station?

lines.zh: 走路只要五分钟。
lines.en: It is only five minutes on foot.

lines.zh: 那我想先看看，明天下午可以吗？
lines.en: Then I would like to see it first. Is tomorrow afternoon OK?

lines.zh: 可以，我跟房东说一下。
lines.en: Sure, I will tell the landlord.

qs.en: How much is the rent a month?
How are water and electricity paid?
Which room is a little smaller?

qs.zh: 男的什么时候去看房子？
qs.en: When will the man go and see the flat?

passages.title: Will I make my flight?
passages.scene: A woman in a taxi is worried about her flight.

lines.zh: 师傅，我要赶下午三点的航班，来得及吗？
lines.en: Driver, I need to catch a three o'clock flight this afternoon. Is there enough time?

lines.zh: 现在一点半，路上如果不堵车，我们一个小时就能到。
lines.en: It is half past one now. If there is no traffic jam, we can get there in an hour.

lines.zh: 可是现在路上车挺多的。
lines.en: But there are quite a lot of cars on the road now.

lines.zh: 别着急，我走高速，高速上车少。
lines.en: Do not worry. I will take the motorway; there are fewer cars on it.

lines.zh: 太感谢了。如果错过了这个航班，我今天就不能回家了。
lines.en: Thank you so much. If I miss this flight, I will not be able to go home today.

lines.zh: 放心吧，一定来得及。
lines.en: Relax, there is definitely enough time.

qs.en: What time is the flight the woman will take?
If there is no traffic jam, how long will it take?
Which way does the driver plan to go?

qs.zh: 如果错过了航班，女的会怎么样？
qs.en: What will happen if the woman misses her flight?

passages.title: Bought online
passages.scene: A man asks a woman about her new coat.

lines.zh: 你这件外套真好看，在哪儿买的？
lines.en: Your coat looks really nice. Where did you buy it?

lines.zh: 我是在网上买的，那时候在打折，只花了三百块。
lines.en: I bought it online. It was being sold at a discount then, so I only spent 300 yuan.

lines.zh: 这么便宜！质量怎么样？
lines.en: That cheap! What is the quality like?

lines.zh: 还可以。但是网购有时候也会买到质量不好的东西。
lines.en: It is OK. But when you shop online, sometimes you also buy things whose quality is not good.

lines.zh: 对，我上次买的鞋，穿了一个星期就破了。
lines.en: True. The shoes I bought last time fell apart after a week.

lines.zh: 所以买之前要先看看别人怎么说。
lines.en: So before you buy, you should first look at what other people say.

qs.zh: 女的外套是在哪儿买的？
qs.en: Where did the woman buy her coat?
How much did the coat cost?

qs.zh: 男的上次买的鞋怎么了？
qs.en: What happened to the shoes the man bought last time?

qs.zh: 女的说网购前要做什么？
qs.en: What does the woman say you need to do before shopping online?

passages.title: After the check-up
passages.scene: A woman asks a friend why he stopped going to the gym.

lines.zh: 你最近怎么不去健身房了？
lines.en: Why have you stopped going to the gym recently?

lines.zh: 我工作压力太大，每天都加班，没有时间。
lines.en: Work is too stressful. I work overtime every day and have no time.

lines.zh: 上个月体检的结果怎么样？
lines.en: What were the results of last month's check-up?

lines.zh: 医生说我的体重增加了五公斤，要多运动，少吃油多的东西。
lines.en: The doctor said my weight has gone up by five kilos, and that I should exercise more and eat less oily food.

lines.zh: 那你每天下班以后去散步吧，半个小时也好。
lines.en: Then you should go for a walk every day after work; even half an hour is good.

lines.zh: 好，我从今天开始。
lines.en: OK, I will start today.

qs.zh: 男的为什么不去健身房了？
qs.en: Why has the man stopped going to the gym?
How much weight has the man put on?
What does the doctor tell the man to do?
opts: 多运动，少吃油多的东西

qs.zh: 女的建议男的每天做什么？
qs.en: What does the woman suggest the man do every day?

passages.title: The meeting is moved
passages.scene: A man calls to ask about tomorrow's meeting.

lines.zh: 你好，我想问一下，明天的会议还按时开吗？
lines.en: Hello, I would like to ask: is tomorrow's meeting still on time?

lines.zh: 不好意思，我正要通知你，会议推迟到下星期三了。
lines.en: Sorry, I was just about to let you know: the meeting has been put back to next Wednesday.

lines.zh: 时间呢？还是上午九点吗？
lines.en: And the time? Is it still nine in the morning?

lines.zh: 改到下午两点了，地点没有变，还是在三楼的会议室。
lines.en: It has been moved to two in the afternoon. The place has not changed: it is still the meeting room on the third floor.

lines.zh: 好的，需要我准备什么材料吗？
lines.en: OK. Do I need to prepare any material?

lines.zh: 请把上个月的调查结果打印出来，每人一份。
lines.en: Please print out last month's survey results, one copy for each person.

qs.zh: 会议推迟到什么时候了？
qs.en: When has the meeting been put back to?
What time is the meeting?
Where is the meeting?
What does the man need to prepare?
opts: 打印上个月的调查结果

passages.title: A misunderstanding
passages.scene: A woman asks a man about a quarrel with a friend.

lines.zh: 你和小明还在生气吗？
lines.en: Are you and Xiaoming still angry with each other?

lines.zh: 已经没事了，其实是一个误会。
lines.en: It is all fine now. It was actually a misunderstanding.

lines.zh: 怎么回事？
lines.en: What is going on?

lines.zh: 他生日那天我没给他打电话，他以为我忘了。
lines.en: I did not call him on his birthday, and he thought I had forgotten.

lines.zh: 其实我那天在飞机上，手机关机了。
lines.en: Actually I was on a plane that day, and my phone was switched off.

lines.zh: 那你跟他解释了吗？
lines.en: So did you explain it to him?

lines.zh: 解释了，也跟他道歉了，他已经原谅我了。
lines.en: I did, and I also apologised. He has already forgiven me.

qs.en: Why did Xiaoming get angry?
opts: 男的在他生日那天没给他打电话

qs.en: Where was the man that day?
Why did the man not call?
How are things with Xiaoming now?

passages.title: A scholarship
passages.scene: A woman tells a friend good news about university.

lines.zh: 你申请的那个大学有消息了吗？
lines.en: Is there any news from the university you applied to?

lines.zh: 有了！我申请成功了，而且还拿到了奖学金。
lines.en: Yes! My application was successful, and I got a scholarship too.

lines.zh: 太棒了！你学什么专业？
lines.en: Brilliant! What subject are you studying?

lines.zh: 教育专业。我将来想当老师。
lines.en: Education. In the future I want to be a teacher.

lines.zh: 学费贵吗？
lines.en: Are the fees expensive?

lines.zh: 奖学金能付一半的学费，剩下的我打算自己打工赚。
lines.en: The scholarship can pay half of the fees; the rest I plan to earn myself with a part-time job.

qs.en: Was the woman's application successful?
What else did the woman get?
What subject is the woman studying?

qs.zh: 剩下的学费女的打算怎么办？
qs.en: How does the woman plan to pay the rest of the fees?

passages.title: Another bag
passages.scene: A woman sees a man buy a bag at the supermarket again.

lines.zh: 你怎么又在超市买袋子了？
lines.en: Why have you bought a bag at the supermarket again?

lines.zh: 我忘记带袋子了。
lines.en: I forgot to bring a bag.

lines.zh: 这种袋子用一次就扔，太浪费了，对环境也不好。
lines.en: This kind of bag is used once and thrown away. It is so wasteful, and it is not good for the environment either.

lines.zh: 你说得对。可是超市的袋子不是免费的，也就几毛钱。
lines.en: You are right. But the supermarket's bags are not free, and they only cost a few jiao.

lines.zh: 不是钱的问题。如果每个人少用一个，我们一年就能减少很多垃圾。
lines.en: It is not about the money. If everyone used one less, we could cut a lot of rubbish in a year.

lines.zh: 好吧，以后我把袋子放在车里，就不会忘记了。
lines.en: All right. From now on I will keep a bag in the car, so I will not forget.

qs.en: What did the man forget to bring?

qs.zh: 女的觉得这种袋子怎么样？
qs.en: What does the woman think of this kind of bag?
How much does a supermarket bag cost?
What does the man plan to do from now on?

passages.title: The forest in the snow
passages.scene: Two friends plan a weekend trip.

lines.zh: 这个周末我们去森林公园玩吧，听说那里的景色特别漂亮。
lines.en: Let's go to the forest park this weekend. I hear the scenery there is especially pretty.

lines.zh: 好啊，但是新闻说周末要降温。
lines.en: Sure, but the news says it will get colder at the weekend.

lines.zh: 会多冷？
lines.en: How cold will it get?

lines.zh: 最冷的时候零下三摄氏度，还可能下雪。
lines.en: At its coldest, minus 3 degrees Celsius, and it might snow.

lines.zh: 下雪更好啊，雪里的森林一定很漂亮。我们多穿一点儿衣服就行了。
lines.en: Snow is even better: a forest in the snow must be beautiful. We just need to wear more clothes.

lines.zh: 好吧，那我们星期六早上八点出发。
lines.en: All right, then we will set off at eight on Saturday morning.

qs.en: Where do they want to go at the weekend?
What will the weather be like at the weekend?

qs.zh: 最冷的时候是多少摄氏度？
qs.en: How cold will it be at its coldest?
When will they set off?

passages.title: No signal
passages.scene: A woman's phone suddenly stops working.

lines.zh: 我的手机突然没有信号了，也不能上网了。
lines.en: My phone suddenly has no signal, and I cannot go online any more.

lines.zh: 你先关机，再重新开机试试。
lines.en: You first switch it off, then switch it on again and try.

lines.zh: 我试过了，还是不行。
lines.en: I tried. It still does not work.

lines.zh: 那可能是手机坏了，你去修理店看看吧。
lines.en: Then maybe the phone is broken. You should take it to a repair shop.

lines.zh: 修理要多少钱？
lines.en: How much will the repair cost?

lines.zh: 要看是什么问题。如果修理太贵，还不如买一个新的。
lines.en: It depends on the problem. If the repair is too expensive, you might as well buy a new one.

qs.en: What is wrong with the woman's phone?
What does the man tell the woman to do first?
What happened when the woman tried?

qs.zh: 男的说如果修理太贵怎么办？
qs.en: What does the man say to do if the repair is too expensive?

passages.title: Grandpa's mornings
passages.scene: A woman talks about her grandfather.

lines.zh: 我爷爷今年七十五岁了，已经退休十五年了。
lines.en: My grandpa is 75 this year and has already been retired for 15 years.

lines.zh: 他每天早上六点起床，先去公园散步，然后回家练书法。
lines.en: He gets up at six every morning, first goes for a walk in the park, and then comes home to practise calligraphy.

lines.zh: 他说练书法能让人心里平静。
lines.en: He says practising calligraphy can make people feel calm inside.

lines.zh: 周末的时候，我们全家都会回去陪伴他。
lines.en: At weekends our whole family will go back to keep him company.

lines.zh: 爷爷说，他最希望全家人都身体健康。
lines.en: Grandpa says what he hopes for most is for the whole family to be healthy.

qs.en: How many years has Grandpa been retired?

qs.zh: 爷爷每天早上先做什么？
qs.en: What does Grandpa do first every morning?

qs.zh: 爷爷觉得练书法有什么好处？
qs.en: What does Grandpa think is good about practising calligraphy?
What will the whole family do at weekends?
What does Grandpa hope for most?

passages.title: Hotpot tonight
passages.scene: A couple decide what to have for dinner.

lines.zh: 今天晚上咱们吃什么？
lines.en: What shall we have tonight?

lines.zh: 天气这么冷，吃火锅吧。
lines.en: It is so cold, let's have hotpot.

lines.zh: 好主意。咱们家里有什么？
lines.en: Good idea. What do we have at home?

lines.zh: 冰箱里有豆腐、土豆和一些蔬菜，不过没有肉了。
lines.en: There is tofu, potatoes and some vegetables in the fridge, but no meat left.

lines.zh: 那我去楼下的便利店买一些牛肉和羊肉。
lines.en: Then I will go to the convenience store downstairs and buy some beef and lamb.

lines.zh: 顺便买一些饮料，再买一些面条。火锅最后煮面条最好吃了。
lines.en: Get some drinks while you are there, and some noodles too. Noodles cooked in the hotpot at the end taste the best.

lines.zh: 行，我十分钟就回来。
lines.en: OK, I will be back in ten minutes.

qs.en: What are they having tonight?
Why does the woman want to have this?
What is there no more of in the fridge?
Where does the man go to buy things?

qs.zh: 女的让男的顺便买什么？
qs.en: What does the woman ask the man to buy on the way?

passages.title: A flat of my own
passages.scene: A man talks to an agent about renting a flat.

lines.zh: 我想租一套公寓，一个人住。
lines.en: I would like to rent a flat to live in by myself.

lines.zh: 您每个月的租金最多能接受多少？
lines.en: What is the most you can accept for the rent each month?

lines.zh: 最好不超过五千。
lines.en: Ideally not more than 5,000.

lines.zh: 这套离地铁站很近，面积不大，可是刚刚装修过，家具和家电都是新的。
lines.en: This one is very close to the metro station. It is not big, but it has just been redecorated, and the furniture and appliances are all new.

lines.zh: 租金四千八百块。
lines.en: The rent is 4,800 yuan.

lines.zh: 押金我要付多少？
lines.en: How much do I need to pay as a deposit?

lines.zh: 押金是一个月的租金。如果没问题，我们明天就可以签合同。
lines.en: The deposit is one month's rent. If there is no problem, we can sign the contract tomorrow.

qs.en: What does the man want to rent?

qs.zh: 男的希望租金最多是多少？
qs.en: What is the most the man hopes to pay in rent?
What is special about this flat?

qs.zh: 这套公寓的租金是多少？
qs.en: How much is the rent for this flat?
How much is the deposit?

passages.title: Fifth birthday sale
passages.scene: An announcement in a shop.

lines.zh: 各位顾客，欢迎光临。
lines.en: Dear customers, welcome.

lines.zh: 为了庆祝本店开业五周年，从今天到这个星期日，所有商品都打折，原来一百块的，现在只要八十块。
lines.en: To celebrate our shop's fifth anniversary, from today until this Sunday, everything is on sale: what used to cost 100 yuan now costs only 80.

lines.zh: 会员每买一百块，还可以再少付十块。
lines.en: Members can also pay 10 yuan less for every 100 yuan they spend.

lines.zh: 另外，购物满五百元，就赠送一个漂亮的杯子。
lines.en: In addition, if you spend 500 yuan, you will get a pretty cup as a gift.

lines.zh: 活动期间，每天营业到晚上十点。祝您购物愉快！
lines.en: During the sale, the shop is open until ten every evening. Wishing you happy shopping!

qs.en: Why is the shop holding this sale?
When does the sale end?

qs.zh: 会员可以享受什么优惠？
qs.en: What extra offer can members get?
opts: 每买一百块再少付十块

qs.en: How much do you need to spend to get a cup?

qs.zh: 活动期间每天营业到几点？
qs.en: Until what time is the shop open each day during the sale?

passages.title: An accident on the way
passages.scene: A woman explains why she is late.

lines.zh: 你怎么这么晚才到？
lines.en: Why are you so late?

lines.zh: 别提了，前面发生了一起车祸，我在路上堵了一个多小时。
lines.en: Do not ask. There was a car accident ahead, and I was stuck on the road for over an hour.

lines.zh: 严重吗？有人受伤吗？
lines.en: Was it serious? Was anyone hurt?

lines.zh: 不太严重，两辆车撞在一起，司机都没事。
lines.en: Not very serious. Two cars hit each other, and both drivers are fine.

lines.zh: 交警说其中一辆车超速了。
lines.en: The traffic police said one of the cars was speeding.

lines.zh: 超速很危险，肯定要罚款吧？
lines.en: Speeding is dangerous. There must be a fine?

lines.zh: 我听说司机不仅要罚款，还可能会被暂停驾照。
lines.en: I heard the driver will not only have to pay a fine, but the licence may also be suspended.

qs.en: Why is the woman late?
opts: 路上发生了车祸，堵车了

qs.en: How long was the road blocked?
Was the accident serious?

qs.zh: 交警说为什么发生了车祸？
qs.en: What did the traffic police say caused the accident?

qs.zh: 超速的司机可能会怎么样？
qs.en: What may happen to the speeding driver?
opts: 被罚款，还可能被暂停驾照

passages.title: Forgot the password
passages.scene: A man helps a woman with an app.

lines.zh: 我想在这个软件上买火车票，可是注册不了。
lines.en: I want to buy train tickets in this app, but I cannot register.

lines.zh: 屏幕上显示什么？
lines.en: What does the screen show?

lines.zh: 它说我的手机号码已经注册过了。
lines.en: It says my phone number has already been registered.

lines.zh: 你是不是以前用过这个软件？你可以用手机号码登录试试。
lines.en: Did you use this app before? You can try logging in with your phone number.

lines.zh: 可是我忘记密码了。
lines.en: But I have forgotten the password.

lines.zh: 没关系，点“忘记密码”，它会给你的手机发一个号码，输入以后就能设置新密码。
lines.en: No problem. Tap "forgot password", and it will send a number to your phone. After you type it in, you can set a new password.

lines.zh: 好了，我登录成功了！
lines.en: There, I have logged in!

qs.zh: 女的想在软件上做什么？
qs.en: What does the woman want to do in the app?
Why can the woman not register?
opts: 她的手机号码已经注册过了

qs.en: What does the man tell the woman to do?

qs.zh: 女的后来遇到了什么问题？
qs.en: What problem did the woman run into next?
What happened in the end?

passages.title: Leaving the job
passages.scene: A man asks a friend why she quit her job.

lines.zh: 我听说你辞职了？
lines.en: I heard you quit your job?

lines.zh: 对，我在那家公司实习了一年，后来又工作了两年，可是待遇一直没有提高。
lines.en: Yes. I was an intern at that company for a year and then worked there for two more years, but the pay and conditions never got better.

lines.zh: 那你接下来打算做什么？
lines.en: So what do you plan to do next?

lines.zh: 我已经投了几份简历，有一家科技公司约我下周面试。
lines.en: I have already sent out a few CVs, and a tech company has asked me to an interview next week.

lines.zh: 科技公司的发展前途不错。
lines.en: Tech companies have good prospects.

lines.zh: 是啊，而且离我家很近，不用每天挤地铁了。
lines.en: Yes, and it is very close to my home, so I will not have to squeeze onto the metro every day.

qs.zh: 女的在原来的公司一共待了几年？
qs.en: How many years in total was the woman at her old company?
Why did the woman quit?
Which company has asked the woman to an interview?
When is the woman's interview?
What is good about the new company?

passages.title: Noisy neighbours
passages.scene: A woman tells a friend about her sleepless nights.

lines.zh: 楼上的邻居每天晚上都很吵，我已经好几天睡不好了。
lines.en: The neighbours upstairs are noisy every night, and I have not slept well for days.

lines.zh: 你跟他们沟通过吗？
lines.en: Have you talked it over with them?

lines.zh: 我上个星期去过一次，他们说家里有孩子，没办法。
lines.en: I went once last week. They said they have children at home and cannot help it.

lines.zh: 那你可以给物业打电话，让物业跟他们说。
lines.en: Then you could call the property management and get them to talk to the neighbours.

lines.zh: 我打过了，物业说会解决，可是到现在一点儿变化都没有。
lines.en: I did. The property management said they would sort it out, but so far nothing has changed at all.

lines.zh: 那你可以晚上戴着耳机听音乐。
lines.en: Then you could wear headphones and listen to music at night.

lines.zh: 我只能先这样了。
lines.en: I can only leave it like that for now.

qs.en: Why can the woman not sleep well?

qs.zh: 女的去找邻居的时候，邻居怎么说？
qs.en: What did the neighbours say when the woman went to see them?
Who does the man suggest the woman contact?
What happened after the property management promised to act?

qs.zh: 男的最后建议女的做什么？
qs.en: What does the man suggest at the end?

passages.title: Sleep well
passages.scene: A doctor gives advice on a radio programme.

lines.zh: 很多年轻人习惯熬夜，晚上玩手机玩到一两点。
lines.en: Many young people are used to staying up late, playing on their phones until one or two at night.

lines.zh: 时间长了，就容易失眠，第二天也没有精神。
lines.en: Over time it is easy to get insomnia, and the next day you have no energy.

lines.zh: 一般来说，成年人每天最好睡七到八个小时。
lines.en: Generally speaking, it is best for adults to sleep seven to eight hours a day.

lines.zh: 睡觉前一个小时最好不要看手机，可以看看书或者听听轻松的音乐。
lines.en: It is best not to look at your phone in the hour before bed; you could read or listen to some relaxing music.

lines.zh: 另外，晚饭不要吃得太饱，也不要喝咖啡和浓茶。
lines.en: Also, do not eat too much at dinner, and do not drink coffee or strong tea.

qs.zh: 很多年轻人有什么习惯？
qs.en: What habit do many young people have?

qs.zh: 熬夜时间长了会怎么样？
qs.en: What can happen if you stay up late for a long time?

qs.zh: 成年人每天最好睡多久？
qs.en: How long is it best for adults to sleep each day?

qs.zh: 睡觉前一个小时最好不要做什么？
qs.en: What is it best not to do in the hour before bed?
How should you eat at dinner?

passages.title: Visiting the elderly
passages.scene: A man tells a friend about his weekend plans.

lines.zh: 这个周末你有什么安排？
lines.en: What are your plans for this weekend?

lines.zh: 我报名参加了社区的志愿者活动，去看望附近的老人。
lines.en: I have signed up for a community volunteer activity: visiting the elderly people nearby.

lines.zh: 你们去了要做什么？
lines.en: What will you do when you get there?

lines.zh: 帮他们打扫卫生，陪他们聊天儿，还教他们用智能手机。
lines.en: Help them clean, keep them company and chat, and also teach them to use smartphones.

lines.zh: 听起来很有意义。下次能带我一起去吗？
lines.en: That sounds really worthwhile. Can you take me with you next time?

lines.zh: 当然可以，下个月还有一次，我提前告诉你。
lines.en: Of course. There is another one next month; I will tell you in advance.

qs.zh: 男的这个周末要做什么？
qs.en: What will the man do this weekend?
Who are they visiting?
What will they teach the elderly people to do?
What does the woman want to do?

qs.zh: 下一次活动是什么时候？
qs.en: When is the next activity?

passages.title: Welcome to the museum
passages.scene: A guide speaks to a tour group.

lines.zh: 各位游客，大家好，欢迎来到本市的历史博物馆。
lines.en: Hello, everyone, and welcome to the city's history museum.

lines.zh: 我们这个城市已经有两千多年的历史了。
lines.en: Our city already has a history of over 2,000 years.

lines.zh: 一楼展出的是古代人用过的工具和生活用品。
lines.en: On the first floor are tools and everyday things that people used in ancient times.

lines.zh: 二楼是书法和国画展览，很多作品都非常珍贵。
lines.en: The second floor has an exhibition of calligraphy and Chinese painting; many of the works are very precious.

lines.zh: 参观的时候请不要拍照，也不要用手摸这些东西。
lines.en: During the visit, please do not take photos, and do not touch these things with your hands.

lines.zh: 参观结束以后，可以在一楼的商店买一些小礼物。
lines.en: After the visit, you can buy some small gifts in the shop on the first floor.

qs.zh: 这个城市有多少年的历史？
qs.en: How long is this city's history?
What is on the first floor?
opts: 古代人用过的工具和生活用品

qs.en: What exhibition is on the second floor?

qs.zh: 参观的时候不能做什么？
qs.en: What may you not do during the visit?
Where can you buy small gifts?

passages.title: To go or not to go
passages.scene: A man is unsure whether to take a job far away.

lines.zh: 我在犹豫要不要去南方工作。
lines.en: I am hesitating over whether or not I want to go and work in the south.

lines.zh: 那边的工资不是比这边高很多吗？
lines.en: Is the pay there not much higher than here?

lines.zh: 是高不少，可是我父母年纪大了，我不想离他们太远。
lines.en: It is quite a lot higher, but my parents are getting old, and I do not want to be too far from them.

lines.zh: 坐高铁回来也就四个多小时，周末也能回家。
lines.en: It is only a little over four hours back by high-speed train, so you could come home at weekends.

lines.zh: 你说得对，可是工作一忙，我说不定一个月都回不了一次。
lines.en: You are right, but once work gets busy, I might not even get back once a month.

lines.zh: 反正还有时间考虑，你跟父母商量一下再决定吧。毕竟这是你自己的事。
lines.en: Anyway, there is still time to think it over. Talk to your parents and then decide. After all, it is your own decision.

qs.en: What is the man hesitating over?
What is the pay like in the south?
Why is the man hesitating?
opts: 父母年纪大了，他不想离他们太远

qs.en: How long does the high-speed train take to get back?
What does the woman suggest the man do?
opts: 跟父母商量一下再决定
